subject: insurance-business-law-08-2022
note: The pipeline-format rendering of section 3 (the fork register) of NOTES.md for row legalese-2026-10-vn-29: Law 08/2022/QH15 on Insurance Business as made (V1), as amended by Law 139/2025/QH15 from 1 January 2026 (V2) and with Điều 2(6) and 2(8) of that Law from 1 July 2026 (V3). The 38 forks F1 to F38, their readings and the reading taken are the encoder's, copied from NOTES.md and not re-decided; where this file found NOTES.md wrong or incomplete the entry's notes say so, prefixed DISCREPANCY. No Vietnamese-qualified lawyer has read any reading, and no authority has settled any fork, so every entry is 'resolved' by the encoder alone. No Interpretation record exists in this encoding, so no entry is an interpretation-field and the interpretation_type is omitted. Completeness is unfalsifiable: the register lists the ambiguities the encoder met, and an ambiguity not met is not in it. Where NOTES records that no reading was taken (F3, F5, F17, F19), the stance actually taken is represented as a live reading. Each source.quote is extracted by tools/make_fork_register.py from the named lines of the raw gazette text, not typed; whitespace is collapsed, so a quote may run across a line break.

site.anchor: Dieu 31(1): the last day for the insurer to pay

source.quote: trong thời hạn 15 ngày kể từ ngày nhận được đầy đủ hồ sơ hợp lệ

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 31(1)
Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 117(2)

readings.description: A period counted in 'ngày' is counted in calendar days, from the day named as day 0 (the last day is that day plus N).

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 117(2)

readings.description: A period counted in 'ngày' is counted in working days.

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 117(2)

readings.rejection_rationale: Điều 117(2) writes 'ngày làm việc' (working days) where it means them; the contrast shows the plain 'ngày' is not that.

taken.rationale: Điều 117(2) writes 'ngày làm việc' (working days) where it means them (src:2559, 2562, 2564); the Law defines neither phrase. The contrast licenses calendar days for the plain 'ngày'. Outside knowledge about the Civil Code's rules on periods is not used.

notes: The quoted clause is one example of the plain 'ngày'; the fork covers every period the NOTES lists. Source lines in NOTES: src:707-708, 723, 761-762, 782, 1307, 1336-1342, 1394-1400, 1541-1542, 1652, 1972, 2039, 2343, 2396-2415.

site.anchor: Dieu 26: the party has the right to terminate on the ground

source.quote: Doanh nghiệp bảo hiểm, chi nhánh doanh nghiệp bảo hiểm phi nhân thọ nước ngoài hoặc bên mua bảo hiểm có quyền đơn phương chấm dứt thực hiện hợp đồng bảo hiểm

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 26

readings.description: Each ground belongs to the side the ground implies: non-payment and unsafe property, the insurer; non-acceptance of a change of risk, either; refusal of a portfolio transfer, the policyholder.

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 26

readings.description: Either side may terminate on every ground.

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 26

readings.rejection_rationale: It would let a policyholder who stopped paying terminate for non-payment.

taken.rationale: The chapeau gives the right to 'doanh nghiệp bảo hiểm ... hoặc bên mua bảo hiểm' without allocating; reading it for either side on every ground would let a policyholder who stopped paying 'terminate for non-payment'.

site.anchor: Dieu 28: the transfer takes effect

source.quote: Việc chuyển giao hợp đồng bảo hiểm chỉ có hiệu lực khi bên mua bảo hiểm

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 28

readings.description: The insured person's consent (life), the transferee's insurable interest, and notice plus the insurer's consent are all required for the transfer to take effect.

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 28

readings.description: Only paragraph 3 is a condition of effect.

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 28

readings.foreclosure: Paragraphs 1 and 2 are written as requirements ('phải được', 'phải có') on the transfer; the encoding treats them as conditions of effect and does not execute this reading.

taken.rationale: Paragraph 2 says the transferee 'phải có' an insurable interest and paragraph 1 requires the written consent; paragraph 3 alone speaks of effect ('chỉ có hiệu lực khi').

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 30(1)

readings.description: The last day of the one year is the anniversary of the starting day, plus the force majeure days.

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 30(1)

citations.cite: Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm số 08/2022/QH15, Điều 30(1)

taken.rationale: '01 năm kể từ ngày xảy ra sự kiện' fixes a year from a day; the Law does not say whether the starting day counts.

notes: The leap-day start (29 February) is not decided and no test asserts it: the library's `add years` clamps to 28 February.
